name: Brute Force
description: Adversaries systematically guess credentials when they do not have them.
detection_guidance: Monitor authentication logs for repeated failures from one source, and for failures spread thinly across many accounts.

name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
description: Repeated authentication attempts against one or more accounts using a list of likely passwords.
detection_guidance: Threshold on authentication failures grouped by source address.

name: Brute Force: Password Spraying
description: A small number of common passwords tried against many accounts to stay below lockout thresholds.
detection_guidance: Count distinct target accounts per source, not attempts per account.

name: Brute Force: Credential Stuffing
description: Credentials from an unrelated breach replayed against the target.
detection_guidance: High failure volume with near-zero repetition of the same username/password pair.

name: Valid Accounts
description: Adversaries use legitimate credentials, which bypasses controls that look for malicious code.
detection_guidance: Baseline per-account behaviour: source addresses, hours, and hosts accessed. Alert on multi-factor deviation, not single novelty.

name: Valid Accounts: Domain Accounts
description: Use of compromised domain credentials, which typically grant access across many systems.
detection_guidance: Correlate a single domain account authenticating to unusual numbers of hosts.

name: Valid Accounts: Local Accounts
description: Use of local account credentials configured by an administrator or by the operating system.
detection_guidance: Monitor local account use on systems where interactive local login is not expected.

name: Valid Accounts: Cloud Accounts
description: Use of compromised cloud identities to access control planes and data.
detection_guidance: Baseline per-identity API usage, source address and MFA state; alert on combined deviation.

name: Account Discovery
description: Adversaries enumerate accounts to understand which identities exist and which are privileged.
detection_guidance: Detect bursts of enumeration commands rather than any single command.

name: Account Discovery: Local Account
description: Enumeration of local accounts via commands such as id, whoami, and reads of /etc/passwd.
detection_guidance: Correlate several enumeration categories from one account within a short window.

name: Account Discovery: Domain Account
description: Enumeration of domain accounts via net, dsquery and directory queries.
detection_guidance: Windows 4798/4799 events and net.exe execution with account arguments.

name: Account Discovery: Cloud Account
description: Enumeration of cloud identities via IAM list and describe APIs.
detection_guidance: Burst of distinct read-only IAM calls from one identity.

name: System Information Discovery
description: Collection of host details such as OS version, architecture and hardware.
detection_guidance: uname, systeminfo, hostnamectl executions, particularly alongside other discovery.

name: System Owner/User Discovery
description: Identification of the primary user or currently logged-on users.
detection_guidance: whoami, w, last, and query user executions.

name: Process Discovery
description: Enumeration of running processes to identify defences and valuable software.
detection_guidance: ps, tasklist and Get-Process executions in sequence with other discovery.

name: Permission Groups Discovery
description: Enumeration of group memberships to find privileged principals.
detection_guidance: groups, net group, and cloud group-listing APIs.

name: Permission Groups Discovery: Cloud Groups
description: Enumeration of cloud group membership and role assignment.
detection_guidance: ListGroups, ListGroupsForUser and equivalent APIs.

name: Network Service Discovery
description: Scanning for reachable services to identify lateral movement paths.
detection_guidance: Many short-lived connections from one host to many destinations or ports.

name: Software Discovery
description: Enumeration of installed software, often to identify security tooling.
detection_guidance: Package manager queries and registry enumeration.

name: Cloud Service Discovery
description: Enumeration of available cloud services and their configuration.
detection_guidance: Describe and list API calls across multiple services from one identity.

name: Cloud Infrastructure Discovery
description: Enumeration of compute, storage and networking resources in a cloud account.
detection_guidance: DescribeInstances, ListBuckets and similar inventory calls.

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
description: Execution of commands and scripts through interpreters.
detection_guidance: Process creation events for shells and interpreters, with attention to unusual parents.

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
description: Use of PowerShell to execute commands and scripts.
detection_guidance: Encoded command arguments, unusual parent processes, and script block logging.

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell
description: Use of Unix shells to execute commands and scripts.
detection_guidance: Shell processes spawned by services or web servers rather than by login sessions.

name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism
description: Circumvention of mechanisms that control elevated privilege.
detection_guidance: Correlate privilege enumeration with successful elevation shortly afterwards.

name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Setuid and Setgid
description: Abuse of setuid/setgid binaries to execute code with the file owner's privileges.
detection_guidance: Filesystem searches for the setuid bit, and changes to setuid permissions.

name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Sudo and Sudo Caching
description: Abuse of sudo configuration or cached credentials to elevate privileges.
detection_guidance: sudo invocations to root, particularly interactive shells, and sudoers modification.

name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
description: Exploitation of a software vulnerability to gain higher privileges.
detection_guidance: Unexpected privileged process ancestry, and crashes preceding privileged execution.

name: Access Token Manipulation
description: Manipulation of access tokens to operate under a different security context.
detection_guidance: Assignment of sensitive privileges such as SeDebugPrivilege at logon.

name: Account Manipulation
description: Modification of accounts to maintain or elevate access.
detection_guidance: Group membership changes, credential additions and permission grants.

name: Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Credentials
description: Creation of additional credentials on an identity to retain access.
detection_guidance: CreateAccessKey and equivalent calls, especially following enumeration.

name: Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Roles
description: Assignment of additional roles or policies to an identity.
detection_guidance: Policy attachment events referencing high-privilege policies.

name: Account Manipulation: SSH Authorized Keys
description: Addition of SSH public keys to authorized_keys files to retain access.
detection_guidance: File integrity monitoring on authorized_keys across the estate.

name: Create Account
description: Creation of a new account to maintain access.
detection_guidance: Account creation events, with particular attention to privileged UIDs and groups.

name: Create Account: Local Account
description: Creation of a local account on a compromised system.
detection_guidance: useradd/net user events; a second UID 0 account is unambiguous.

name: Create Account: Cloud Account
description: Creation of a cloud identity to maintain access.
detection_guidance: CreateUser and CreateRole calls from identities that do not normally provision.

name: Scheduled Task/Job
description: Scheduling of code to run automatically, providing execution and persistence.
detection_guidance: Creation of scheduled tasks and cron entries, especially outside change windows.

name: Scheduled Task/Job: Cron
description: Use of cron to schedule execution of malicious code.
detection_guidance: File creation in /etc/cron.* and /var/spool/cron.

name: Scheduled Task/Job: Scheduled Task
description: Use of the Windows Task Scheduler to execute code.
detection_guidance: Event ID 4698 and file creation under System32\Tasks.

name: Create or Modify System Process
description: Creation or modification of system-level services to execute code repeatedly.
detection_guidance: Service installation events and unit file creation.

name: Create or Modify System Process: Systemd Service
description: Creation or modification of systemd services for persistence.
detection_guidance: File creation under /etc/systemd/system and /lib/systemd/system.

name: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service
description: Creation or modification of Windows services for persistence.
detection_guidance: Event ID 7045 and service configuration changes.

name: Remote Services
description: Use of valid accounts with remote services to move between systems.
detection_guidance: Authentication to hosts an account does not normally access.

name: Remote Services: Remote Desktop Protocol
description: Use of RDP to interactively access remote systems.
detection_guidance: Logon type 10 events and connections to port 3389.

name: Remote Services: SSH
description: Use of SSH to access remote systems.
detection_guidance: Internal host-to-host SSH, particularly to hosts outside the account's baseline.

name: Remote Services: Windows Remote Management
description: Use of WinRM to execute commands on remote systems.
detection_guidance: Connections to ports 5985/5986 and WSMan provider activity.

name: Lateral Tool Transfer
description: Copying of tools between systems inside the environment.
detection_guidance: File writes to newly accessed hosts shortly after authentication.

name: Ingress Tool Transfer
description: Transfer of tools from an external system into the environment.
detection_guidance: curl/wget/certutil executions with remote URLs on servers.

name: Application Layer Protocol
description: Use of standard application protocols to blend command and control with normal traffic.
detection_guidance: Beaconing patterns and connections to indicators from threat intelligence.

name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
description: Use of HTTP/HTTPS for command and control.
detection_guidance: Regular-interval outbound connections with small, consistent payload sizes.

name: Unsecured Credentials
description: Discovery of credentials stored insecurely on systems.
detection_guidance: Access to credential files, key material and configuration containing secrets.

name: Unsecured Credentials: Private Keys
description: Collection of private key material from compromised systems.
detection_guidance: Reads of id_rsa and equivalent key files by unexpected processes.

name: OS Credential Dumping
description: Extraction of credential material from the operating system.
detection_guidance: Access to LSASS memory on Windows and to shadow files on Linux.

name: OS Credential Dumping: /etc/passwd and /etc/shadow
description: Reading of local credential files to obtain password hashes.
detection_guidance: Any read of /etc/shadow by a process other than the expected authentication stack.

name: Impair Defenses
description: Disabling or degrading security controls and logging.
detection_guidance: Changes to logging configuration and security agent state.

name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
description: Disabling of security tooling to avoid detection.
detection_guidance: Service stop events for security agents.

name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Logs
description: Disabling of cloud audit logging to remove visibility.
detection_guidance: StopLogging, DeleteTrail and event selector modification.

name: Indicator Removal
description: Deletion or modification of artefacts to remove evidence.
detection_guidance: Log truncation and history file clearing.

name: Domain or Tenant Policy Modification
description: Modification of directory or tenant policy to escalate and persist.
detection_guidance: Changes to trust policies and conditional access configuration.

name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
description: Data theft over the existing command and control channel.
detection_guidance: Outbound transfer volume that deviates from the host's baseline.

name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
description: Data theft to a legitimate external web service.
detection_guidance: Large uploads to file-sharing and paste services.

name: Data from Cloud Storage
description: Collection of data from cloud storage objects.
detection_guidance: Unusual volume of object reads, or policy changes exposing a bucket.
